properties.name: Jezero western delta front
properties.description: Lake-deposited delta sediments with high biosignature-preservation potential
properties.caveat: Approximate position of the western fan-delta front, digitized from NASA mission context maps; verify against the Perseverance traverse map before use.
properties.science_goal: Lake-deposited delta sediments with high biosignature-preservation potential

properties.name: Seitah (crater floor, olivine-rich layered rocks)
properties.description: Olivine-rich igneous layers, possibly the oldest exposed rocks in Jezero
properties.caveat: Approximate position; NASA describes Seitah as a sandy, rocky crater-floor unit west of the landing site. Verify against the Perseverance traverse map.
properties.science_goal: Olivine-rich igneous layers, possibly the oldest exposed rocks in Jezero

properties.name: Pahrump Hills (base of Mount Sharp)
properties.description: Murray formation mudstones at the base of Mount Sharp (ancient lake deposits)
properties.caveat: Center of HiRISE image ESP_039280_1755 acquired while Curiosity was at Pahrump Hills (13 Dec 2014); the outcrop lies within that frame, not exactly at its center.
properties.science_goal: Murray formation mudstones at the base of Mount Sharp (ancient lake deposits)
